codeReview.summary: The feature mostly wires action metadata/discovery/dispatch correctly, but manifest action-id validation has a correctness hole that can admit malformed IDs and break deterministic runtime matching.

issues.description: `validate_plugin_actions` trims `action.id` before character validation and duplicate tracking, so IDs with leading/trailing whitespace are accepted even though the rule claims only ASCII alphanumeric, `-`, and `_` are allowed. Runtime registration/dispatch compares exact untrimmed IDs (`crates/gpui_plugin/src/gpui_plugin.rs:466`, `crates/plugin_host/src/plugin_host.rs:881`), so this can produce manifest actions that pass validation but fail to bind predictably. Reject IDs where `id != id.trim()` or validate the original string.

sharedStateObservations.observation: This handoff omitted `skillFeedback`, which makes procedure-adherence auditing inconsistent across the mission.
